title: Enforcement Decree of the Civil Execution Act
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Civil Execution Act and matters necessary for its implementation. <Amended on July 1, 2011>

Article 2 (Living Expenses Exempt from Attachment)
"Money in an amount prescribed by Presidential Decree" in subparagraph 3 of Article 195 of the Civil Execution Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means 2.5 million won: Provided, That where there is money falling under the following subparagraphs, it means the amount obtained by subtracting the amount of that money from 2.5 million won:
1. Deposits exempt from attachment pursuant to Article 246 (1) 8 of the Act;
2. Deposits exempt from attachment pursuant to Article 246 (1) 9 of the Act (including installment savings, installment deposits, deposits in custody, and postal giro transfers; hereinafter referred to as "deposits, etc.").

Article 3 (Minimum Amount Exempt from Attachment)
"Amount prescribed by Presidential Decree in consideration of the minimum cost of living under the National Basic Living Security Act" in the proviso to Article 246 (1) 4 of the Act means 2.5 million won per month. <Amended on July 1, 2011; March 5, 2019; January 27, 2026>

Article 4 (Maximum Amount Exempt from Attachment)
"Amount prescribed by Presidential Decree in consideration of the living expenses of a standard household" in the proviso to Article 246 (1) 4 of the Act means the sum of the amounts specified in subparagraphs 1 and 2, which shall be no less than the amount specified in subparagraph 1. <Amended on July 1, 2011>
1. 3 million won per month;
2. One half of the amount obtained by subtracting the amount specified in subparagraph 1 from the amount exempt from attachment under the main clause of Article 246 (1) 4 of the Act (meaning the amount calculated on a monthly basis).

Article 5 (Method of Calculation Where Salary Claims Overlap or Are of Multiple Types)
When calculating the amounts under Articles 3 and 4, if a debtor receives a salary from multiple workplaces or receives multiple types of salary, the aggregate amount thereof shall constitute the salary claims. <Amended on July 1, 2011>

Article 6 (Scope of Protection-Type Insurance Proceeds, etc. Exempt from Attachment)
(1) Pursuant to Article 246 (1) 7 of the Act, claims to insurance proceeds, surrender refunds, and maturity refunds under protection-type insurance that fall under the following subparagraphs shall be exempt from attachment. <Amended on January 27, 2026>
1. An amount not exceeding 15 million won out of death insurance proceeds;
2. The following insurance proceeds among the proceeds of protection-type insurance received by a debtor due to injury, illness, accident, etc.:
(a) Insurance proceeds intended to cover expenses actually incurred for treatment and recovery from disability, such as medical consultation fees, treatment expenses, surgery expenses, hospitalization expenses, and medication expenses;
(b) An amount equivalent to one-half of the insurance proceeds for treatment and recovery from disability, excluding the insurance proceeds falling under item (a);
3. The following refunds among surrender refunds under protection-type insurance:
(a) Surrender refunds arising where a creditor exercises, by subrogation, the debtor's right to terminate an insurance contract pursuant to Article 404 of the Civil Act, or where a creditor who has obtained a collection order or an assignment order exercises the right to terminate;
(b) An amount not exceeding 2.5 million won out of surrender refunds arising on grounds other than the grounds for termination prescribed in item (a);
4. An amount not exceeding 2.5 million won out of maturity refunds under protection-type insurance.
(2) Where there are two or more insurance contracts under which a debtor acquires claims to insurance proceeds, surrender refunds, or maturity refunds under protection-type insurance, the amounts under the subparagraphs of paragraph (1) shall be calculated according to the following classifications:
1. Paragraph (1) 1, 3 (b), and 4: The respective upper limits for claims exempt from attachment shall be calculated against the amounts obtained by separately aggregating death insurance proceeds, surrender refunds, and maturity refunds across the relevant insurance contracts;
2. Paragraph (1) 2 (b) and 3 (a): The amounts shall be calculated separately for each insurance contract.

Article 7 (Scope of Deposits, etc. Exempt from Attachment)
The amount of deposits, etc. exempt from attachment pursuant to Article 246 (1) 9 of the Act shall be deposits, etc. with a balance not exceeding 2.5 million won per person: Provided, That where any of the following funds exist, the amount shall be the amount remaining after subtracting the amount of such funds from 2.5 million won:
1. Money exempt from attachment pursuant to subparagraph 3 of Article 195 of the Act;
2. Deposits exempt from attachment pursuant to Article 246 (1) 8 of the Act.

Article 8 (Financial Institutions for Opening Living Expense Accounts)
(1) "Financial institutions prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 246-2 (1) of the Act means the following financial institutions:
1. Banks under the Banking Act;
2. The Korea Development Bank under the Korea Development Bank Act;
3. The Industrial Bank of Korea under the Industrial Bank of Korea Act;
4. Mutual savings banks under the Mutual Savings Banks Act;
5. Cooperatives and NongHyup Bank under the Agricultural Cooperatives Act;
6. Cooperatives and Suhyup Bank under the Fisheries Cooperatives Act;
7. Credit unions under the Credit Unions Act;
8. Cooperatives under the Forestry Cooperatives Act;
9. Community credit cooperatives under the Community Credit Cooperatives Act;
10. Postal service offices under the Postal Savings and Insurance Act.
(2) "Amount prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 246-2 (1) of the Act means 2.5 million won.
(3) Interest on amounts deposited in a living expense account under Article 246-2 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "living expense account" in this Article), including interest already deposited, may be paid even where payment of such interest causes the amount held in the living expense account or the amount deposited into that account during one month to exceed the amount under paragraph (2).
(4) When opening or closing a living expense account, a financial institution under paragraph (1) shall, with the depositor's consent, immediately notify the comprehensive credit information collection agency under Article 25 (2) 1 of the Credit Information Use and Protection Act of the depositor's name, resident registration number, and matters concerning the opening or closing of the living expense account, through computers or other telecommunications media.
(5) Before opening a living expense account, a financial institution under paragraph (1) shall, with the depositor's consent, request the comprehensive credit information collection agency under paragraph (4) to check whether the depositor has opened a living expense account at another financial institution. In such cases, the comprehensive credit information collection agency receiving the request shall comply with it.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 18964, July 26, 2005>

This Decree shall enter into force on July 28, 2005.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 23004, July 1, 2011>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on July 6, 2011.

Article 2 (Applicability Concerning Living Expenses and Salary Claims Exempt from Attachment)
The amended provisions of Articles 2 and 3 shall apply beginning with the first case involving an application for an attachment order received after this Decree enters into force.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 29603, March 5, 2019>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on April 1, 2019.

Article 2 (Applicability Concerning Living Expenses, Salary Claims, and Deposits, etc. Exempt from Attachment)
The amended provisions of Articles 2, 3, and 7 shall apply to cases involving applications for attachment orders received after this Decree enters into force.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 36056, January 27, 2026>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on February 1, 2026.

Article 2 (Applicability Concerning Living Expenses, Salary Claims, Protection-Type Insurance Proceeds and Other Payments, and Deposits, etc. Exempt from Attachment)
The amended provisions of Articles 2, 3, 6, and 7 shall apply to cases involving applications for attachment orders received after this Decree enters into force.
